gloss: nape of the neck; scruff of the neck

definitions.gloss: nape of the neck; scruff; collar area
definitions.explanation: The back of the neck near the collar. Often used in the context of grabbing someone by the collar or scruff.

examples.japanese: {襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかまれた。
examples.english: I was grabbed by the scruff of the neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかんで⟦{引|ひ}き{戻|もど}した→引き戻す：25833_hikimodosu⟧。
examples.english: The mother grabbed the child by the collar and pulled him back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{逃|に}げよう→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧とした⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかんで、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}さえつけた。
examples.english: The officer grabbed the man trying to flee by the scruff of the neck and pinned him down on the spot.

notes:
Literally the area where the collar (⟦{襟|えり}→襟：06487_eri⟧) meets the neck (⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧). Most commonly appears in the phrase {襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ (to grab by the scruff).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ (to grab by the scruff)
- {襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかまえる (to seize by the collar)
- {襟首|えりくび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧ (to pull by the collar)

The word evokes a forceful, physical action — often used when describing someone being restrained or dragged. In figurative usage, it can suggest being caught or cornered.
